architecture: encoder of setup C, code 128; decoder draws 11 room classes and the walls
preprocessing: greyscale, invert (walls bright, background dark), pad to a square with black, resize to 128x128 (Lanczos); then cleaned: keep only lines thinner than 5 px (plan minus its 5x5 opening), scale by the 90th percentile of its lines, threshold 0.35; pixels 0-1

outputs.rooms: N x 12 x 128 x 128: channels 0-10 room classes (argmax), channel 11 walls (logit)

similarity: Euclidean distance between codes; smaller = more similar
